qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Unrivaled primary-bank relationships with Nordic multinational corporations and the Wallenberg industrial network; entrenched corporate cash management and custody create high switching costs, driving consistent 14-16% multi-cycle ROE and leading European cost efficiency (cost-to-income ~35-40%).
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 5, REJECT). While SEB is a premier Nordic corporate bank with strong returns (ROE ~14-16%) anchored in the Wallenberg ecosystem, commercial banking possesses low base-rate competitive advantage persistence (CAP < 15Y). Earnings power remains inherently cyclical, tied to central bank interest rate cycles and vulnerable to private credit disintermediation.
qualitative.evidence: Leading Nordic corporate bank with ~40% primary relationship share among Swedish large caps. Strong track record with 2018-2024 ROE averaging ~14.5% and efficient ~36% cost-to-income ratio. However, commercial banks suffer from low empirical persistence due to macroeconomic credit cycles, interest rate sensitivity (NII normalization as Riksbank/ECB cut rates), and capital market disintermediation, capping CAP at 5 years.
